```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
params <- list(

  crc_mrna_stability_file = "data/DE_results/stability_analysis/combined_primary_bootstrap_LOO_stability.csv",

  mrna_stability_flag_column = "bootstrap_robust_effect",




  output_root = "bootstrap_validated_downstream_analysis",

  fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
  logfc_cutoff = 1
)

core_packages <- c(
  "dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "stringr", "ggplot2", "ggVennDiagram", "svglite"
)

missing_core <- core_packages[
  !vapply(core_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_core) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required R packages: ",
    paste(missing_core, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

set.seed(20260805)

  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H",

stable_crc_de_dir <- file.path(

as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) {
    return(replace(x, is.na(x), FALSE))
  }

  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(!is.na(x) & x != 0)
  }

  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in%
    c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")
}

save_placeholder_svg <- function(
    file,
    title,
    detail = "No results available"
) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.15,
      label = title,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = -0.10,
      label = detail,
      size = 4
    ) +
    xlim(-1, 1) +
    ylim(-1, 1) +
    theme_void()

  ggsave(
    file,
    p,
    width = 7,
    height = 5,
    device = "svg"
  )

  invisible(p)
}

write_empty_csv <- function(file, columns) {
  x <- as.data.frame(
    setNames(
      replicate(
        length(columns),
        logical(0),
        simplify = FALSE
      ),
      columns
    )
  )

  write.csv(
    x,
    file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Build bootstrap-validated CRC and UCEC mRNA files

```{r prepare-bootstrap-validated-mrna-results}
read_stability_table <- function(
    stability_file,
    id_column,
    flag_column,
    dataset_name
) {
  if (!file.exists(stability_file)) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " stability table not found: ",
      stability_file
    )
  }

  stability <- read.csv(
    stability_file,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  required_columns <- c(
    "Contrast",
    id_column
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(stability)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " stability table is missing columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (flag_column %in% names(stability)) {
    stability$selected_stable <- as_flag(
      stability[[flag_column]]
    )
  } else if (
    all(c("Method", "robust_effect") %in% names(stability))
  ) {
    stability <- stability[
      grepl(
        "bootstrap",
        stability$Method,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    stability$selected_stable <- as_flag(
      stability$robust_effect
    )
  } else {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": could not find stability flag '",
      flag_column,
      "' or long-format Method/robust_effect columns."
    )
  }

  stability %>%
    transmute(
      Contrast = trimws(
        as.character(Contrast)
      ),
      Feature = trimws(
        as.character(
          .data[[id_column]]
        )
      ),
      selected_stable =
        selected_stable
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Contrast),
      Contrast != "",
      !is.na(Feature),
      Feature != ""
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      Contrast,
      Feature
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      selected_stable = any(
        selected_stable,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

build_validated_result_files <- function(
    dataset_name,
    original_dir,
    stability_file,
    output_dir,
    stable_only_dir,
    id_column,
    stability_flag_column
) {
  stability <- read_stability_table(
    stability_file = stability_file,
    id_column = id_column,
    flag_column = stability_flag_column,
    dataset_name = dataset_name
  )

  assessed_contrasts <- unique(
    stability$Contrast
  )

  count_rows <- vector(
    "list",
    length(contrast_names)
  )

  names(count_rows) <- contrast_names

  for (contrast_name in contrast_names) {
    source_file <- file.path(
      original_dir,
      paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")
    )

    if (!file.exists(source_file)) {
      stop(
        "Missing ",
        dataset_name,
        " result file: ",
        source_file
      )
    }

    tab <- read.csv(
      source_file,
      row.names = 1,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE
    )

    feature_ids <- trimws(
      rownames(tab)
    )

    contrast_assessed <-
      contrast_name %in% assessed_contrasts

    stable_ids <- stability %>%
      filter(
        Contrast == contrast_name,
        selected_stable
      ) %>%
      pull(Feature)

    tab$bootstrap_assessed <-
      contrast_assessed

    tab$bootstrap_stable <-
      contrast_assessed &
      feature_ids %in% stable_ids

    write.csv(
      tab,
      file.path(
        output_dir,
        paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")
      )
    )

    write.csv(
      tab[
        tab$bootstrap_stable,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ],
      file.path(
        stable_only_dir,
        paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")
      )
    )

    primary_significant <-
      !is.na(tab$FDR) &
      !is.na(tab$logFC) &
      tab$FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff &
      abs(tab$logFC) >= params$logfc_cutoff

    count_rows[[contrast_name]] <- tibble(
      Dataset = dataset_name,
      Contrast = contrast_name,
      Bootstrap_assessed =
        contrast_assessed,
      Features_tested = nrow(tab),
      Primary_significant =
        sum(primary_significant),
      Bootstrap_stable_total =
        sum(tab$bootstrap_stable),
      Bootstrap_stable_significant =
        sum(
          primary_significant &
            tab$bootstrap_stable
        ),
      Primary_significant_not_stable =
        if (contrast_assessed) {
          sum(
            primary_significant &
              !tab$bootstrap_stable
          )
        } else {
          NA_integer_
        }
    )
  }

  bind_rows(count_rows)
}

crc_mrna_counts <- build_validated_result_files(
  dataset_name = "CRC_mRNA",
  original_dir = params$original_crc_de_dir,
  stability_file = params$crc_mrna_stability_file,
  output_dir = stable_crc_de_dir,
  stable_only_dir = stable_crc_only_dir,
  id_column = "Gene",
  stability_flag_column =
    params$mrna_stability_flag_column
)

ucec_mrna_counts <- build_validated_result_files(
  dataset_name = "UCEC_mRNA",
  original_dir = params$original_ucec_de_dir,
  stability_file = params$ucec_mrna_stability_file,
  output_dir = stable_ucec_de_dir,
  stable_only_dir = stable_ucec_only_dir,
  id_column = "Gene",
  stability_flag_column =
    params$mrna_stability_flag_column
)

mrna_validation_counts <- bind_rows(
  crc_mrna_counts,
  ucec_mrna_counts
)

write.csv(
  mrna_validation_counts,
  file.path(
    params$output_root,
    "CRC_UCEC_mRNA_bootstrap_validation_counts.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  mrna_validation_counts,
  caption = "CRC and UCEC mRNA bootstrap-validation counts."
)
```

## Gene sets and overlap plots

```{r deg-helper-functions}
read_deg <- function(
    file,
    contrast_name,
    flip_logfc = FALSE
) {
  df <- read.csv(
    file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column(
      "Gene"
    ) %>%
    as_tibble()

  required_columns <- c(
    "logFC",
    "FDR",
    "bootstrap_assessed",
    "bootstrap_stable"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(df)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns in ",
      file,
      ": ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  df$bootstrap_assessed <- as_flag(
    df$bootstrap_assessed
  )
  df$bootstrap_stable <- as_flag(
    df$bootstrap_stable
  )

  if (flip_logfc) {
    df$logFC <- -df$logFC
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      contrast = contrast_name,
      sig =
        bootstrap_assessed &
        bootstrap_stable &
        !is.na(FDR) &
        !is.na(logFC) &
        FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff &
        abs(logFC) >= params$logfc_cutoff,
      direction = case_when(
        sig & logFC > 0 ~
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H",
        sig & logFC < 0 ~
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H",
        TRUE ~
          "Not significant"
      ),
      neglog10FDR =
        -log10(
          pmax(FDR, 1e-300)
        )
    )
}

save_venn <- function(sets, title, file, high_color) {
  if (all(vapply(sets, length, integer(1)) == 0)) {
    save_placeholder_svg(file, title, "No bootstrap-stable significant features")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  p <- ggVennDiagram(sets, label_alpha = 0) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = high_color) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
  ggsave(file, p, width = 7, height = 6, device = "svg")
  p
}
```

```{r load-deg-results-and-plot}
crc_mssh_vs_msih <- read_deg(
  file.path(stable_crc_de_dir, "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H.csv"),
  "CRC_MSS/TMB-H_vs_MSI-H",
  flip_logfc = TRUE
)
crc_mssh_vs_mssl <- read_deg(
  file.path(stable_crc_de_dir, "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.csv"),
  "CRC_MSS/TMB-H_vs_MSS/TMB-L"
)
ucec_mssh_vs_msih <- read_deg(
  file.path(stable_ucec_de_dir, "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H.csv"),
  "UCEC_MSS/TMB-H_vs_MSI-H",
  flip_logfc = TRUE
)
ucec_mssh_vs_mssl <- read_deg(
  file.path(stable_ucec_de_dir, "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.csv"),
  "UCEC_MSS/TMB-H_vs_MSS/TMB-L"
)


crc_sets <- list(
  "CRC: MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H" = crc_mssh_vs_msih %>% filter(sig) %>% pull(Gene),
  "CRC: MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L" = crc_mssh_vs_mssl %>% filter(sig) %>% pull(Gene)
)
save_venn(crc_sets, "Overlap of bootstrap-stable DEGs in CRC", file.path(deg_plot_dir, "venn_crc_significant_degs.svg"), "#56B4E9")

combined_sets <- list(
  "CRC\nMSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H" = crc_mssh_vs_msih %>% filter(sig) %>% pull(Gene),
  "CRC\nMSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L" = crc_mssh_vs_mssl %>% filter(sig) %>% pull(Gene),
  "UCEC\nMSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H" = ucec_mssh_vs_msih %>% filter(sig) %>% pull(Gene),
  "UCEC\nMSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L" = ucec_mssh_vs_mssl %>% filter(sig) %>% pull(Gene)
)
save_venn(combined_sets, "Overlap of bootstrap-stable CRC and UCEC DEGs", file.path(deg_plot_dir, "venn_crc_ucec_significant_degs.svg"), "#CC79A7")
```
